verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP documents realtime destinations to dozens of pre-configured tools. These include CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), SaaS tools (Braze, Customer.io) and Slack, plus a generic webhook to any HTTP endpoint. Destinations support filtering, testing, metrics and logs, and editable Hog code, with batch exports covering scheduled delivery. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of destination delivery, and explicit evidence of ad-platform destinations.
